svg.title: Music editor song tab — piano roll (proposal)
svg.desc: A .msong open in an editor tab: transport bar, track headers with mute/solo/arm, arrangement with clips, loop region and playhead, and the piano roll with keyboard, notes and velocity lane for the selected clip.
svg.text: Arrangement and piano roll are drawn
with the 2D canvas in a SubViewport;
transport, headers and mixer are RmlUi.
Proposal mockup — sizes and spacing indicative. Buttons are icon buttons with tooltips (editor convention).
